mustDo: Keep the field near-black, not navy-gray cards
Use amber, gold, and lavender bars with black ink on fills

mustNot: Drop shadows, glass blur, or 3D bevels
White cards on a light page
Emoji icons or default blue links
tables: Header is a solid amber bar with black condensed uppercase. Rows sit on black with a 1px #3a2200 separator. No zebra. Hover tints #1a0f00. Selected row uses a left amber rail.
lists: No bullets. Flush items with an 8px amber left bar. Ordered lists use tabular decimal-leading-zero catalog numbers in white.
controls: Buttons are flat color lozenges, no border, uppercase labels. Inputs are black with an amber underline only. Checkboxes are small orange lozenges with a black inset when on. Focus is a 2px gold rectangle. Motion is a 80-160ms brightness pulse.
icons: Geometric lozenges and bars only, 14-18px. Duplicate-rectangle copy glyph. No pictograms.
backgrounds: Pure black field. Optional 4px amber scan suggestion at 3% opacity. No wallpaper, no mesh, no vignette.
scrollbars: 18px, black track, orange pill thumb, purple on hover, no overlay style.
sidebarTreatment: Left LCARS rail: orange header capsule, stacked end-capped dataset blocks cycling orange, lavender, blue, gold. Section titles are orange bars with right stadium caps.
titlePaneTreatment: Top orange strip labeled LCARS with a round right cut. Title in condensed gold uppercase on black. Disclaimer is a left-thick orange rail, not a yellow warning card.
modalTreatment: Black plate with an orange stadium header rail and a darker orange footer rail. No drop shadow. Tabs are orange/brown lozenges sitting on an 8px amber bar.
